title: CtrlAltBen Frontier Model Tracker catalogue checkpoint
comment: The full normalised state of one source in one region at one run. A seed checkpoint starts a chain of observation files; a monthly checkpoint is a full-state re-statement that a replay can verify against. The watcher writes the file minified; the schema does not care. See docs/catalogue-contract.md.

source.comment: The listing the run read. The v1 value is arm; the vocabulary is open.

region.comment: The ARM lowercase region identifier, for example uksouth.

observed_at.comment: The run this state was read at. A checkpoint dates the observation, never the changes that led to it.

observed_from.comment: The literal label for the vantage point of the run, for example 'standard pay-as-you-go subscription'.

snapshot_sha256.comment: SHA-256 of the full normalised snapshot the watcher holds privately.

model_key.comment: name@version exactly as the API spells them, case preserved. The version is a build identifier, never a date.

first_seen.comment: The first run at which this entry was seen present. It is an observation date, not the date the model arrived.

watched.comment: The watched subset of a model entry. systemData timestamps are never watched and never appear here.

lifecycle_status.comment: The raw API value, shown beside its portal word from schema/lifecycle-mapping.json.

lifecycle_portal.comment: The portal word for lifecycle_status from schema/lifecycle-mapping.json; null when the value is unmapped.

cell.comment: One deployment type of one model entry in the region. Capacity is a moment, read at capacity_at, not a standing quantity.

deployment_type.comment: The ARM skuName, or none when the row carries skus: [].

capacity.comment: Absent, not zero, when capacity was not read.
